name: Calc Groups Cathedral
tagline: Build a cathedral of Calculation Groups on a real Direct Lake Semantic Model. 12 KPI variations, minimum base measures.
description: Master Calculation Groups by replacing 12 redundant DAX measures with a single elegant calc group. Build a Direct Lake Cathedral_Model from a synthetic Sales lakehouse, then craft Time Intelligence pillars (Current, LY, YoY, YTD, MTD, Rolling12...) with surgical DAX. Every submission is graded on 3 contexts and rewarded with an elegance score. Earn ranks from Stonemason to Cathedral Builder.
learning_objectives: Understand Calculation Groups in Direct Lake semantic models
Replace N redundant time-intelligence measures with 1 calc group
Build and validate measures programmatically with sempy-labs
Stream telemetry to Eventhouse and visualize a player dashboard

items.name: Cathedral_LH
items.description: Holds synthetic Sales / Date / Customer / Budget Delta tables (3 years), populated by 01_Setup.

items.name: Cathedral_EH
items.description: Telemetry of submissions, pass/fail, elegance, rank promotions. Default KQL DB (same name) is auto-provisioned and hosts CathedralEvents.

items.name: 01_Setup
items.description: Run once: generate synthetic Sales/Date/Customer/Budget, load to Cathedral_LH, build Direct Lake Cathedral_Model with the seed measure.

items.name: 02_Quest
items.description: Quest brief: the 12 pillars and the Final Challenge (1 calc group with 11 items).

items.name: 03_Check
items.description: Validates the 12 measures + calc group, scores elegance, assigns rank, ships telemetry.

items.name: 04_Dashboard
items.description: Live progress dashboard (Plotly): state, timeline, measures vs calc group, session recap.

calc_group.note: DistinctCustomers stays a standalone measure because it changes the aggregation, not the time context.
